signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Not all receivers need fancy footwork. When they enter the zone, they have increased success chance on stiff arm and truck attempts following the catch.
When lined up at any wide receiver position, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Receivers with this ability have a high success rate when creating separation on the last cut of any route.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS.
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus deep routes 20+ yards from the LoS.
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Defenders with this ability will dominantly win run blocks when they correctly use the Guess Play adjustment to predict a run. Incorrect guesses will result in a loss.
Defenders with this ability do not need to spend a point on shed attempts during a run play
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in deep zone coverage, 20+ yards from the LoS and inside the numbers.
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from LoS
Defenders with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against receivers, tight ends, and running backs.
